responsibility: This header declares the mc front end's compiler-option interface. It exports the option parser plus the getter and setter routines for quiet/verbose and internal-debug modes, preprocessor command line, output file, header prefix, opaque and qualification settings, scaffolding and GCC config/system behavior, GPL-header emission, noreturn suppression, and bool-type selection, defining the shared configuration contract used across the front end.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the shared declaration interface for GmcOptions.cc, exposing option parsing plus getters/setters for compiler configuration, but not the backing state, parsing code, or header-emission helpers.
